article.title: Why Data Freshness Needs Its Own Service-Level Objective
article.why: Treat freshness separately from pipeline success and availability.

paragraphs.en:
A data pipeline can be green on every monitoring dashboard and still deliver the wrong business experience. The jobs ran, the tables exist, and queries return successfully, yet the newest records may be hours or days late. This is why data freshness deserves to be monitored as a first-class reliability dimension rather than being inferred from job success.

Availability answers whether data can be accessed. Correctness asks whether values are accurate. Freshness asks whether the data is recent enough for its intended use. These dimensions overlap, but they are not interchangeable. A table containing perfectly correct data from yesterday is available and correct, but it may be unusable for a campaign that must react to purchases from the last hour.

A freshness service-level objective, or SLO, makes the requirement explicit. For example: ‘95% of daily customer features must be updated by 7:00 a.m., and no production feature may be more than 26 hours behind its source.’ The exact target depends on the decision. Monthly finance reporting and real-time fraud detection obviously require different freshness levels.

The measurement should use business timestamps when possible. Pipeline completion time alone can be misleading because an upstream source may have stopped updating before the pipeline began. Track the maximum event date or source extraction timestamp and compare it with the expected watermark. This detects the dangerous case where a pipeline successfully processes stale input.

Partition checks are especially useful in warehouses. If today’s partition is missing, or contains far fewer rows than normal, the system should not silently publish downstream tables as healthy. Volume checks, watermark checks, and freshness thresholds complement one another. None is sufficient by itself.

Dependencies also need ownership. A downstream team may meet its own runtime target but still miss the freshness SLO because an upstream feed arrives late. The operational process should show which dependency caused the delay and who is responsible for recovery. Otherwise teams spend incidents proving that their own job was green instead of restoring the business data product.

Freshness alerts should reflect user impact. A five-minute delay may be irrelevant for a weekly report but critical for an automated decision. Alert thresholds should therefore follow the consumption pattern, not simply the technical schedule. It is often useful to define warning and critical levels so that teams can investigate drift before an SLO breach affects users.

Finally, report freshness over time. Measure the percentage of runs meeting the SLO, the size of delays, and recurring upstream causes. This turns isolated incidents into an improvement program.

Reliable data is not merely data that exists when queried. It must arrive at the time the decision expects it. By giving freshness its own objective, metric, and ownership, teams can distinguish a successful pipeline run from a successful data product.
paragraphs.zh:
資料 pipeline 即使 monitoring dashboard 全部是綠色，也可能提供錯誤的商業體驗。Job 成功、table 存在、query 也能執行，但最新紀錄可能已延遲數小時甚至數天。因此 data freshness 應被當成獨立的一級 reliability dimension，而不能從 job success 推論。

Availability 問資料能否存取，correctness 問數值是否正確，freshness 則問資料是否新到足以支援預定用途。三者相關但不可互換。昨天的資料可能完全正確也可查詢，但若 campaign 必須對最近一小時的購買反應，它仍然不可用。

Freshness SLO 會把要求明確化。例如：「95%的每日 customer features 必須在上午7點前更新，任何 production feature 不得比 source 落後超過26小時。」實際 target 取決於 decision；月度財務報告與即時 fraud detection 的 freshness 當然不同。

可能的話應使用 business timestamp 衡量。只看 pipeline completion time 可能誤導，因為 upstream source 可能在 pipeline 開始前就停止更新。應追蹤最大 event date 或 source extraction timestamp，並與 expected watermark 比較，才能發現 pipeline 成功處理 stale input 的危險情況。

Warehouse 中 partition check 特別有用。如果今天 partition 缺失，或 row 數遠低於平常，系統不應仍把 downstream table 標成 healthy。Volume check、watermark check、freshness threshold 應互相補充，沒有任何單一檢查足夠。

Dependency 也需要 ownership。Downstream team 可能達成自己的 runtime target，卻因 upstream feed 延遲而違反 freshness SLO。Operational process 應清楚顯示哪個 dependency 造成延遲，以及誰負責 recovery，否則 incident 時大家只是在證明自己的 job 是綠色，而不是恢復 business data product。

Freshness alert 應反映 user impact。對週報而言五分鐘延遲無關緊要，對 automated decision 卻可能很嚴重。因此 alert threshold 應依 consumption pattern，而不是單純依技術 schedule。也可以設 warning 與 critical levels，在真正 SLO breach 前先調查 drift。

最後要長期報告 freshness：SLO 達成率、delay 大小、反覆發生的 upstream 原因。如此才能把零散 incident 轉成 improvement program。

可靠資料不只是 query 時存在的資料，它還必須在 decision 期待的時間到達。給 freshness 獨立 objective、metric 與 ownership，團隊才能區分「pipeline 跑成功」與「data product 成功」。
paragraphs.ja:
data pipelineのmonitoringが全てgreenでも、business experienceは失敗していることがあります。jobは成功しtableも存在しqueryも通るのに、最新recordが数時間・数日遅れているケースです。data freshnessはjob successから推測するのではなく、独立したreliability dimensionとして監視すべきです。

availabilityはdataへaccessできるか、correctnessは値が正しいか、freshnessは用途に対して十分新しいかを問います。昨日のdataが完全に正しくquery可能でも、直近1時間の購入へ反応するcampaignには使えないかもしれません。

freshness SLOで要件を明示できます。例えば「daily customer featureの95％を7時までに更新し、production featureはsourceから26時間以上遅延させない」。必要水準はdecisionによって異なり、月次finance reportとreal-time fraud detectionでは当然違います。

可能ならbusiness timestampで測ります。pipeline completion timeだけでは、upstream sourceが開始前から更新停止していても気づけません。最大event dateやsource extraction timestampをexpected watermarkと比較すれば、stale inputを正常処理したケースを検知できます。

warehouseではpartition checkも有効です。当日partitionがない、row数が通常より極端に少ない場合、downstream tableをhealthyとして公開すべきではありません。volume、watermark、freshness thresholdを組み合わせます。

dependencyにはownershipも必要です。downstream team自身のruntimeは正常でもupstream feed遅延でfreshness SLOを外すことがあります。どのdependencyが原因で誰がrecoveryを担当するかを示さないと、incident時に各teamが自分のjobはgreenだと証明するだけになってしまいます。

freshness alertはuser impactに合わせます。weekly reportなら5分遅延は無視できますがautomated decisionでは重大かもしれません。technical scheduleだけでなくconsumption patternからthresholdを決め、warningとcriticalを分けるのも有効です。

さらにSLO達成率、delay量、繰り返すupstream原因を継続reportします。個別incidentを改善活動へ変えられます。

reliable dataとはqueryできるdataだけではありません。decisionが必要とする時刻に届くdataです。freshnessに独立したobjective、metric、ownershipを与えることで、pipeline runの成功とdata productの成功を区別できます。

business.term: The pipeline succeeded, but the data product missed its freshness SLO.
business.explanation: 區分技術成功與資料產品時效失敗。
